snippet.title: Scrongly Trailer
snippet.description:
This new, rewritten from the ground up version of Scrongly is available now!

Play now free on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457930/Scrongly/?beta=0

Or on itch

https://silverdubloons.itch.io/scrongly

Please let me know what you think, leave a comment and a review! I appreciate all the feedback I get.

If you're feeling generous, please consider supporting me on Ko-Fi

https://ko-fi.com/silverdubloons
